notes: v2: paler ruddy clean-shaven skin, grey-blue eyes with lids, green collar, buttoned pocket flaps. Face now reads flat and mask-like; collar patches stick out as stubs; neck is too thick.

defects.text: Face reads flat: nose, nostril wings and philtrum too subtle after shortening; cheeks puffy.
defects.fix: Narrower, more defined nose with a clear tip and wings; slimmer cheeks; clearer nasolabial fold in texture.

defects.text: Collar patches are axis-aligned boxes that stick out of the curved collar.
defects.fix: Curved patches following the collar surface.

defects.text: Neck is too thick and long.
Nose shorter, ears larger, jaw narrower.
Skin tone, eyes, lids and lips improved; stubble removed.
Dark green collar and flaps with buttons added.
